2677e79a.text:
Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.
2677e79a.title: Raven Hill Tome

3728af3c.text:
Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.
3728af3c.title: Raven Hill Tome

b0897304.text:
Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.
b0897304.title: Raven Hill Tome

b38214e6.text:
Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.
b38214e6.title: Raven Hill Tome

d557c053.text:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.
d557c053.title: Raven Hill Tome

ec82091a.text:
Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.
ec82091a.title: Raven Hill Tome

1287|fe52f4ea.name: Marda Weller
1287|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1289|fe52f4ea.name: Gunther Weller
1289|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

2456|105cd232.name: Newton Burnside
2456|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2456|2237a3b1.name: Newton Burnside
2456|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256730|fb965f91.name: Stondry Darkhammer
256730|fb965f91.text: The ingots are for display only!

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

5491|837f02f9.name: Arthur the Faithful
5491|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

128-accept.name: Guard Howe
128-accept.text:
The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
128-accept.title: Blackrock Bounty

143-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-complete.text: Good Messenger, you have served your master well.
143-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
144-accept.text:
Magistrate Solomon's note pains me to read.  But it is obvious he knows not the war which is waged in Westfall or else he would know better than to expect aid from the Militia.  If Stormwind had not deserted us as well, we would not have the need for the Militia.

Take this response to your master in Redridge, $c.  And let him know that my heart is heavy with the loss of good men.
144-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-complete.text:
I do say, this is not good at all.  I did not realize that Stoutmantle's situation was not unlike ours here in Lakeshire.  What action is so important that it calls the Stormwind Army away from its people?  Bah, I should not ponder aloud.

Here, messenger.  Accept these coins in exchange for your service to the Township.  I might call upon you again.
144-complete.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
145-accept.text: I require your assistance once again.  I have written to Lord Ebonlocke, requesting that he sends his trained guards, the Night Watch, to help with Lakeshire's defense.  It is imperative this message makes it to him swiftly.  You must exercise extreme caution.  Ebonlocke is the mayor of Darkshire, in the heart of Duskwood.  Do not stray from the roads.
145-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

148-accept.name: Abercrombie
148-accept.text:
Oh, what is a poor old man to do?  I need some supplies from Darkshire, but the village is so far away and I am so old and feeble...I would never make the trip.

Can you go to Darkshire and bring me back some Ghost Hair Thread?  You can get it from Madame Eva at her home on the Darkshire square.
148-accept.title: Supplies from Darkshire

148-complete.name: Madame Eva
148-complete.text: Ah, Ghost Hair Thread is what you need, is it?  I'm afraid I have none in stock, but I can make some for you...if you can supply the ghost hair.
148-complete.title: Supplies from Darkshire

149-accept.name: Madame Eva
149-accept.text:
There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.

Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair.  Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.

And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...
149-accept.title: Ghost Hair Thread

149-complete.name: Blind Mary
149-complete.text:
What is this?  A comb?  It's lovely!  And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.

Oh, if only I had a mirror...
149-complete.title: Ghost Hair Thread

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-accept.text:
Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!

Hunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
150-accept.title: Murloc Poachers

154-accept.name: Blind Mary
154-accept.text:
NO!!!!!

Take it, take this comb away from me!

I'm a monster, and no one will ever think me lovely again!
154-accept.title: Return the Comb

154-complete.name: Madame Eva
154-complete.text: I can make a spool of Ghost Hair Thread with this, and have a few strands to spare.  Here are some coins for those extra strands.
154-complete.title: Return the Comb

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

157-accept.name: Madame Eva
157-accept.text: Here is your thread, $N.  It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
157-accept.title: Deliver the Thread

157-complete.name: Abercrombie
157-complete.text:
Delightful!  This will do splendidly...

Here, good $N, take this as payment for your honorable deed.
157-complete.title: Deliver the Thread

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

158-accept.name: Abercrombie
158-accept.text:
I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice.  Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.

And please hurry, $N.  These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
158-accept.title: Zombie Juice

163-complete.name: Jitters
163-complete.text: No! Please don't kill me! It's just me... Jitters!! They're everywhere... I can't escape them! Monsters in Raven Hill? N-n-n-o... couldn't be. Only harmless Jitters.
163-complete.title: Raven Hill

164-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
164-complete.text: These supplies will be most useful. The aid of the Carevin family is always appreciated. Here is a little something for your trouble.
164-complete.title: Deliveries to Sven

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-complete.name: Abercrombie
165-complete.text:
Elaine Carevin? Hehe, oh yes... of course, the Carevins.

No, nothing's wrong but it is hard for me to go into town now. The roads are dangerous and I'm not getting any younger. Maybe you can do an old man some favors?
165-complete.title: The Hermit

1650-complete.name: Daphne Stilwell
1650-complete.text:
Hello, $N. I'm assuming by all that armor and weapon of yours, you're either here to try and take my land, or the Church finally sent someone to help protect me while my Jordan's gone.

Well, let me introduce myself: I'm Daphne Stilwell. It's a pleasure.

Now, you're not too late... I've only killed a half dozen of the scum since last sun up. They've been a little slow getting 'round the bend up there, but they probably saw you coming, which means they'll probably be here any minute.
1650-complete.title: The Tome of Valor

1651-accept.name: Daphne Stilwell
1651-accept.text:
Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.

I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.

I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.

Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... did you hear that? I think they're coming.

We make our stand near the house!
1651-accept.title: The Tome of Valor

1651-complete.name: Daphne Stilwell
1651-complete.text:
We've done it, $N! Thank you for your help. You were truly amazing out there. I never thought a $c could handle so many enemies at once.

You've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
1651-complete.title: The Tome of Valor

1651-progress.name: Daphne Stilwell
1651-progress.text: We'll make our stand at the house!
1651-progress.title: The Tome of Valor

1652-accept.name: Daphne Stilwell
1652-accept.text:
Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.

He'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.

Oh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.
1652-accept.title: The Tome of Valor

1652-complete.name: Duthorian Rall
1652-complete.text:
So, we meet again, $N, and you are in high spirits, I see.

The Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.

Daphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.

For your valor, you will be rewarded.
1652-complete.title: The Tome of Valor

1653-accept.name: Duthorian Rall
1653-accept.text:
Actually, I have no doubt that Jordan himself would like to thank you, and seeing as I need a messenger to send word that his wife is safe, I think you'd be a perfect choice.

Jordan was to be a $c of the Light before his dedication to his father's craft took him on another path--he's intimately familiar with our way of life and is considered among our most faithful.

He should still be in Ironforge--he likes to work outside the gates during the day, something about the cool mountain air.
1653-accept.title: The Test of Righteousness

174-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-accept.text:
My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.

Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
174-accept.title: Look to the Stars

174-complete.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-complete.text: This is perfect, $N.  The first step is complete!
174-complete.title: Look to the Stars

174-progress.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-progress.text: Have you found a skilled engineer to create a bronze tube yet?
174-progress.title: Look to the Stars

175-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
175-accept.text: According to Cog's blueprint, what I need now is a way to reflect light.  I remember a woman by the name of Mary who became well known around these parts for always carrying a looking glass.  Perhaps you can track Mary down and see if she might lend us a reflective surface for this project?  I believe she once resided in southern Duskwood. . .
175-accept.title: Look to the Stars

175-complete.name: Blind Mary
175-complete.text: Why yes, I used to own a looking glass.
175-complete.title: Look to the Stars

177-accept.name: Blind Mary
177-accept.text: The looking glass was one of my finest treasures until. . .the incident.  After that happened, I discarded it behind the barn.  There was an Insane Ghoul who used to roam back there.  Perhaps he picked it up.  Rumor has it the devilish beast resides in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.
177-accept.title: Look to the Stars

226-accept.name: Lars
226-accept.text:
Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all.  And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food.  It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite.  It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work!

But if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it.  They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
226-accept.title: Wolves at Our Heels

226-complete.name: Lars
226-complete.text:
Oh good.  You thinned out that pack quite a bit, and without those wolves nipping out our heels, we can bind our minds to dealing with Morbent Fel.

Here, take some of these Flash Bundles.  They make them in town, and a lot have been donated to Sven to help with his cause.
226-complete.title: Wolves at Our Heels

230-accept.name: Unknown
230-accept.text:
Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.

The book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.
230-accept.title: Sven's Camp

230-complete.name: Sven Yorgen
230-complete.text:
<Sven reads the book's pages, then slams it shut.>

That shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death!  There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!
230-complete.title: Sven's Camp

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

245-accept.name: Watcher Dodds
245-accept.text:
Hail, $c. Perhaps you've seen those spiders that have taken over the western border? The eight-legged menaces are too much for us to handle, and the Commander hasn't enough manpower to spare so far from Darkshire.

I hate to ask this of you, but you seem like you might be able to handle them. I can't promise you anything of great value, but I can reward you if you can help root out the filthy bugs.

Oh, and a word of advice, you'll want to avoid their venom if you can.
245-accept.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

245-progress.name: Watcher Dodds
245-progress.text:
You'd best be careful when dealing with the spiders, I've lost a few of my men to them, and trust me, it isn't a pleasant sight to see a man hanging upside down in their webs after the venom has started to soften them up.

I wouldn't want to see one of the bugs having you for lunch.
245-progress.title: Eight-Legged Menaces

262-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
262-accept.text:
I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!

Please, $N, you have shown your resourcefulness.  Please find that shadowy figure.  I must learn what secrets he holds!

I do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm.  Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.
262-accept.title: The Shadowy Figure

5-accept.name: Jitters
5-accept.text:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
5-accept.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

5-complete.name: Chef Grual
5-complete.text: You need some Crab Cakes, do you?  Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
5-complete.title: Jitters' Growling Gut

93-accept.name: Chef Grual
93-accept.text:
I'll let you in on a little secret - Dusky "Crab" Cakes are really made from spider legs!  I know it's a bit disgusting, but the cakes have a nice, tangy flavor and make great snacks!  Bring me Gooey Spider Legs and I'll whip you up a few of them.

I hear Venom Web Spiders are a good source - they nest to the north, between the foothills and the river.
93-accept.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

95-accept.name: Sven Yorgen
95-accept.text:
I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something.  He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders.  So I never discovered what was hidden.

If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful.  The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.
95-accept.title: Sven's Revenge

95-complete.name: Unknown
95-complete.text: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
95-complete.title: Sven's Revenge

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label
